pages.title: Slot Reference
pages.text:
Container (Entity or Vec3), Slot Number (double) -> Slot Reference -> SlotReference
Order doesn't matter, pops container and slot number, generates a reference object pointing to that item slot.

Container can be entity (Entity) or coordinate (Vec3).
Slot number starts from 0.
Mana cost: None
Returned SlotReference can be used for subsequent charging, item access (coming soon), and other operations.
